tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and end by H=0.48. The H≈20 probe tests the predicted sign reversal near the forecast horizon and constrains the slow response before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. Different pairs can fit the pilot and give materially different predictions at H=23.6.
Finer early-time sampling would mainly refine the fast response rather than directly measure the late-time reversal.
It does not constrain the slow adaptation term or the late-time response.
